verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal's offline-mode docs say payments can be stored locally on the POS device or smart reader during connectivity issues. They also say the SDK or reader automatically forwards stored payments to Stripe once the network returns, which covers both halves of the story. Missing for 10: documented operational details (offline transaction limits, decline/risk handling for stored payments, supported reader coverage) and independent or hands-on corroboration that offline store-and-forward works in practice.
